thread:
jessica: FYI — Acme Corp (acct: ACME-42) on a support call. Their corporate card is being declined when paying invoices through our UI. Happened 3x in last 2 hours, customer is asking for an immediate workaround.

billing-bot: Payment failure log -> charge_id=ch_3JkL9, gateway=payment-gw, decline_code=do_not_honor (05), acquirer_code=05, mcc=5812, amount=12450.00, currency=EUR, invoice=INV-2026-0345

matt (finance): Do we have MCC 5812 in any internal allowlist for corporate customers? Procurement claims ACME allows travel/restaurant spend but their card program might block by default.

sam (eng-billing): From our side the acquirer returned: 
```
{
  "error": "card_declined",
  "decline_code": "do_not_honor",
  "network_code": "05",
  "mcc": "5812",
  "amount": 12450,
  "currency": "EUR"
}
```
Repro steps I ran: 1) POST /v1/invoices/INV-2026-0345/charge with card_token tok_visa_live 2) got same response above.

jessica: Repro steps for support:
1) Customer opens invoice in dashboard -> Pay with corporate card
2) Select card on file -> Submit
3) Error modal shows generic "Payment failed" only. No decline detail for them.

matt (finance): Looking at ACME profile: their billing settings have `require_po=true` and their corporate card program enforces per-transaction limit of 10,000 EUR and monthly cap of 25,000 EUR. The attempted charge (12,450 EUR) exceeds the single-transaction limit. That alone explains a 05.

jessica: Oh — customer assumed we would split charges or handle PO automatically. They didn't attach a PO to the invoice. They want either: (A) a temporary whitelist/exception for our MCC so their card authorizes, or (B) manual payment via wire today and retry card after PO is added.

sam (eng-billing): Two different failure modes: 1) MCC block (issuer-side merchant category restriction) 2) card limits. For MCC block, we can't change issuer rules from our side — it requires the issuer or the customer's corporate card admin to allow MCC 5812 ("Eating places/Restaurants"). We can, however, surface MCC in the decline message and open a ticket with payment-gw to ask if they can send more descriptive auth hints.

matt (finance): I can take (B) — we can accept a wire today and mark invoice paid manually. But customer asked for a faster in-product fix for future charges.

jessica: Customer wants us to try to 1) add PO metadata to invoice so their AP system shows match, 2) suggest splitting payment under 10k or use alternate card. They also asked if we can pass `po_number` in auth payload.

sam (eng-billing): We do have an optional `metadata.po_number` field we can send to the gateway. Sending it may help some corporate setups that verify merchant-level metadata, but most banks still decline purely on MCC/limit policy. I'll add code to include any invoice.po_number in the auth payload in a hotfix.

ops-oncall: Pinging payments team to escalate — @sam please create vendor escalation with payment-gw and include the raw auth logs. Priority: high. :eyes:

billing-bot: Escalation created: ES-8421 -> payment-gw. Owner: sam (eng-billing).

sam (eng-billing): Created internal ticket PAY-1598: include PO in auth payload + surface decline_code in UI. Also opened ES-8421 with payment-gw asking for issuer clarification on MCC 5812 declines.

matt (finance): For this immediate invoice, I'll prepare a manual payment path. @jessica can you confirm wire details have been sent to the customer and mark invoice pending_manual_payment?

jessica: Confirmed — customer will wire today. They'll also request a PO number from their procurement and will retry card next week. Please keep this thread open until we confirm a successful card charge after PO and/or alternate card.

sam (eng-billing): I'll update PAY-1598 with outcome from payment-gw and push the UI tweak to show mapped decline reasons (low risk change). ETA: 48 hrs for small UI + backend flag.

matt (finance): After the wire posts, I'll reconcile and close the billing exception. Thanks everyone.

jessica: Closing loop plan: owner(s) = [sam (eng-billing) -> payments escalation + backend change, matt (finance) -> manual payment/reconcile]. Leaving thread open until ACME confirms successful retry. :white_check_mark:
